description: Item-by-item reading of the system (paper-eval-v2) replies to eval/datasets/held_out_ambiguous_everyday.jsonl against each item's expected_behavior and must_avoid, judged on the whole conversation (first reply and the forced give-up reply). The forced give-up turn asks for 'its answer', which pushes the last reply to a single 'Answer:' line; an item passes when the conversation shows the expected behaviour and no reply presents one answer as the only one possible.
